description: Latvian company members (SIA) from the official Uzņēmumu reģistrs open data (CC0, daily): number of shares, nominal value and currency as published, share of nominal capital, holding start date. Corporate holders are named with their registration number; natural persons, individual merchants included, are COUNTED, never named (GDPR). Group links for KYB. The register withdrew joint-stock companies' shareholders from open publication (November 2026): an AS or SE returns 404 actionnaires_non_publies_par_le_registre, not billed, with blocs_absents naming the actionnaires block (reason jeu_retire_par_la_source). The answer carries the company's statut and statut_detail: an active company with none gets aucun_associe_inscrit: true; a struck-off company whose records the register removed returns 404 radiee_inscriptions_retirees, not billed; one that keeps some is served under partial coverage. Legal persons only: an individual merchant (IK), a sole trader or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
